intro: Lesson 13: Review and check: cleanliness, shapes, numbers and endings. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

box.title: Two sentences I will say to the camera

questions.q: Read the sentence and say what it means: أَغْسِلُ يَدَيَّ بِالصَّابُونِ.
questions.a: I wash my hands with soap.

questions.q: Unit check on the pupil PDF: read and write five words, match shapes, write three numbers, then say two sentences to the camera.
questions.a: Words, shapes, numbers and sentences from the unit

questions.q: Extend: write a sentence with a number and a shape.
questions.a: For example: هٰذَا مُرَبَّعٌ وَاحِدٌ (this is one square)
A) مِنْشَفَتُهَا. ـهَا = her; ة becomes ت.

questions.q: Think again: which word do you like most?
